card.name: Words after contact/absorb phrases
card.fires_on: Marked words in the middle of set phrases about contacting someone for help or information, such as 'contact the source cited above' or 'contact a physician'. It also fires on connecting words after ocean carbon absorption.

modes.label: Contact instructions
modes.description: Word inside a stock instruction to contact a source, physician or poison center.
modes.example: For further information, please contact the source<< cited>> above.

modes.label: Overdose advice
modes.description: Word in an overdose or poisoning instruction about whom to contact.
modes.example: In case of overdose, contact<< a>> physician or Poison Control Center right away.

modes.label: Ocean carbon absorption
modes.description: Linking word or participle after a clause on the ocean absorbing carbon dioxide.
modes.example: thus<< providing>> a much-needed service in slowing climate change

card.writes: No clear meaning; it suppresses rescue and revive words and slightly favors odd name endings.
card.plain: It fires on filler words inside stock 'contact the source or a physician' lines, and on a few words in ocean carbon text.
